quote: Said driver having so yielded may proceed and the drivers of all other vehicles approaching the intersection on the through highway shall yield right-of-way to the vehicle about to enter or cross the through highway.

activation.condition: Driver on through highway approaches an intersection where the entering or crossing driver has so yielded.

obligation.description: Yield right-of-way to the vehicle about to enter or cross the through highway.

timing.description: Observe antecedent and both approaching vehicles before and during intersection conflict.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Preceding subsection A source and original entering-driver approach require independent review; speed alone is insufficient.
Original two-actor route, proximity, conflict order and through-driver response need source-backed review.

parameter_refs.name: antecedent_pause_s
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: 0 to 4 seconds engineering request; no legal cutoff

parameter_refs.name: through_approach_speed_mps
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: 4 to 12 m/s engineering request; no legal cutoff
